=={{header|Omegese}}==
{{works with|omc|sha256 2c824805, aien-dev/omega-mv e5b32567, Linux AArch64}}
Omega has no imports, so the small output helpers (<code>emit</code> and friends) are part of the program.
<syntaxhighlight lang="text">
om2
text nl "\n"
text cc "C("
text eqs ") = "
text by " by the recurrence, "
text sum " by the convolution sum\n"
text hdr "n, C(n) by C(n+1) = 2(2n+1)/(n+2) C(n), and again by C(n+1) = sum C(i) C(n-i):\n"
note emit writes every byte of a to stdout; a short write is retried, an error exits 1
fn emit a view uchar * to void
o = ulong 0
while lt o len a bound 4096
k = write 1 a o sub len a o
if le k 0
exit 1
end
o = add o ulong k
end
end
note emitu writes n in decimal; 20 digits hold every ulong
fn emitu n ulong to void
d = new uchar 20 0
i = ulong 20
v = n
while true bound 20
i = sub i 1
put d i uchar add rem v 10 48
v = div v 10
if eq v 0
break
end
end
emit part d i sub 20 i
end
note cs holds C(0)..C(14) from the convolution; all stay below 2^32, so every product fits
fn main to int
cs = new ulong 15 0
put cs 0 1
for n ulong 14
s = ulong 0
for i ulong add n 1
s = add s mul get cs i get cs sub n i
end
put cs add n 1 s
end
emit hdr
c = ulong 1
for n ulong 15
emit cc
emitu n
emit eqs
emitu c
emit by
emitu get cs n
emit sum
c = div mul c mul 2 add mul 2 n 1 add n 2
end
ret 0
end
</syntaxhighlight>
